snippet.title: Afterglow Bytes: Reverie by the Shore - Official Teaser Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Run a cozy izakaya in futuristic Bali in Afterglow Bytes: Reverie by the Shore. Grill skewers, serve patrons, help wandering spirits, and manage supplies to keep your evening haven alive. Every night tells a new story. Afterglow Bytes: Reverie by the Shore will be available on PC.
